0.label: How to prepare for a massage session?
0.body: Avoid heavy meals 1.5 hours before the session. It is advisable to take a hygienic shower before the procedure.

1.label: Which massage to choose if it's my first time?
1.body: For the first time, a classic relaxing full-body massage or a back and neck massage is a great choice.

2.label: How many sessions are needed for a noticeable effect?
2.body: To relieve severe tension and improve health, a course of 8–10 sessions 2–3 times per week is recommended. For maintenance, 1 session per week is enough.

3.label: Is it normal to feel pain after a massage?
3.body: Mild soreness (like after a workout) for 1–2 days after deep muscle work is a normal body reaction.

0.label: What types of massage do you offer at your studio?
0.body: We offer medical, sports, restorative, Swedish, relaxing, lymphatic drainage and anti-cellulite massage, as well as IQ bodywork. The technique is chosen individually.

1.label: How do I know which massage is right for me?
1.body: Before your first session we hold a consultation, clarifying your complaints, health condition and your preferences. On this basis we select the appropriate massage technique.

2.label: Can I book a massage if I have back and neck pain?
2.body: Yes, we work with muscle tension, stiffness and discomfort in the back and neck. Before the procedure we assess your condition and rule out any contraindications.

3.label: Where is your studio located?
3.body: We see clients at two branches — in Ramat Gan and Petah Tikva. You can choose whichever location is most convenient for you.

4.label: Can I buy a pass for several sessions?
4.body: You can buy passes, certificates or gift cards as you wish. The terms for issuing them can be clarified when booking. We will also help you choose the optimal frequency of procedures depending on your goals.

5.label: How do I book a massage?
5.body: Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram, telling us the service you would like and your preferred branch. We will help you choose a specialist and arrange a time for your visit.
